name: Sky Ladder
description:
SKY LADDER. The one with the islands stacked into the sky: a short, easy climb from the meadow to the highest island, hopping from island to island, then turning back and hopping on up above the islands you came by. The career's first floating islands, with the meadow under every one of them.
ROUTE AND APPLES: 1) A grassy kicker on the meadow throws you up onto island 0; apple 1 hangs over its near edge. 2) Island 0's curved lip throws you up onto island 1, and island 1's lip over the lip of the hill island. 3) The hill island: a ramp up to a crest with an apple tree, and behind the crest a hollow you can't see from below. Apple 2 floats in it: the one you go looking for. The rim beyond is steep: ride up it, roll back, turn (Space) and ride back over the crest. 4) Down the ramp at speed, the hill island's lip throws you high and back west, up onto the first upper island above island 1; apple 3 floats over its edge. 5) Two more hops up, each lip throwing you onto the next island's landing shoulder; apple 4 floats over the top island's edge by the potato stall. 6) The finish: a steep bank up to the summit, with the flower floating by the old apple tree and the rock.
SKILLS: momentum (every lip wants a run-up, and the ramp gives the big hop its speed), small hops off kickers, turning around (once, on the hill island), big air (level the bike before each landing). New: taking off from one island and landing on another, higher or lower. No turning in the air.
RECOVERY: there is ground under every island. Miss on the lower row and you land on the meadow: ride back to the start kicker, or to the west-facing kicker under the hill island, which throws you back onto island 1. Miss on the upper row and you drop onto a lower island and ride up again. Fly off the rim and you land on the meadow. The summit rock stops a rider who reaches the top still short of an apple.
ENDS: the bank behind the start, the overhanging bank in the east, and the summit rock.
lesson: Floating islands. Hop up from one island onto the next, and drop onto lower ones, climbing into the sky over a meadow that catches every miss.
alsoNew: Floating meadows stacked into the sky with roots hanging beneath them, and a potato stall on the highest island.
